name: tailscale
title: Tailscale
description: Sign in to a tailnet from the browser: a controller (createTailscale) with a sign-in state machine (interactive login URL in a popup, or a pre-auth key from your server), a lazily created tailnet client behind a small structural interface, session persistence that can be encrypted in the passkey vault, a routing policy (*.ts.net, 100.64.0.0/10, your hosts and subnets) and React hooks (TailscaleProvider, useTailscale, useTailscaleStatus, useTailscaleFetch).
